subject.title: feat: discover OpenCode and Pi sessions on paired nodes

question: Should bundled OpenCode and Pi catalogs activate and discover readable native transcripts by default on the Gateway and approved paired nodes?
rationale: Code review can verify mechanics, but it cannot decide whether automatic transcript discovery and trusted synthetic node scopes are the intended default privacy, compatibility, and operator policy.

options.title: Approve after repair
options.body: Keep the default-on design after both findings are fixed and final-head fresh-install, upgrade, relative-path, and paired-node proof is posted.

options.title: Make discovery opt-in
options.body: Ship the catalog providers disabled by default so operators explicitly enable transcript discovery and node access.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Do not land the catalogs if the added startup, configuration, and transcript-disclosure surface is not worth the maintenance and trust cost.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the default-on design after both findings are fixed and final-head fresh-install, upgrade, relative-path, and paired-node proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the linked direction and implementation and is the strongest available routing candidate for the default and trust-model choice.
